name: University of Choices
source:
Your dad just cut you off. Now it's sink or swim at university, but who says you can't have some fun while you figure it out?

At 20, your comfortable life of gaming and hanging out just got flipped upside down. After one too many fights, your father delivered an ultimatum: succeed at this private university, or lose his support forever. But university life isn't just about grades, it's about the people you meet, the choices you make, and discovering who you really want to become.

[From [url=https://french-pie-games.itch.io/university-of-choices]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你爸爸刚刚打断了你。现在在大学里是成败的事情，但谁说你在搞清楚事情的同时就不能享受一些乐趣呢？

20岁时，你舒适的游戏和闲逛生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。经过多次争吵后，你的父亲发出了最后通牒：在这所私立大学取得成功，否则永远失去他的支持。但大学生活不仅仅关乎成绩，还关乎你遇到的人、你所做的选择，以及发现你真正想成为的人。

[来自[url=https://french-pie-games.itch.io/university-of-choices]itch.io[/url]]
